record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: Reports a refusal outcome after an abliteration weight edit, testing practical removal by a different, anchored projection procedure.
record.gate_note: The README reports a 32-prompt safety-removal evaluation. Its task-speed, retrieval, and truncation results do not test the claim versions. The abliteration description does not state that its direction is the harmful-minus-harmless mean-activation difference.
record.test_reason: The repo applies an abliteration weight edit to a released model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp). It reports refusal counts before and after the edit on a 32-prompt set. That bears on V2 in a new model setting. The recipe differs from the original: λ=3.5 over-projection, layers 10–35 only, and an unstated direction source. So T3 (new setting) fits better than T2.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. The README presents the edited checkpoint as having safety refusals removed (32/32 bypass vs 7/32 stock). It also claims anchoring the edit to layers 10–35 preserves speculative-decoding acceptance. Its main focus is serving performance, not refusal mechanics.
record.recipe_differences: This is an integration/tool repository, not a stated reproduction of the original method. It uses an anchored wo_b projection with λ=3.5 and edits layers 10–35 only (26 tensors); the README does not specify the original method's recipe for comparison.

fits_no_version.finding: Projecting through the speculative-drafter layers makes the target stop refusing. But the stock drafter keeps proposing refusal-shaped tokens and draft acceptance collapses. Anchoring (leaving layers 36–42 and the MTP layers unedited) avoids this. The claim is stated, not measured.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Abliteration must be applied consistently across draft and target components, or the speculative-decoding pipeline degrades.

record.problems: The refusal evaluation is reported as counts for 32 prompts, with no uncertainty estimate or further prompt-set or judge details. The README does not report a general-capability comparison between stock and edited checkpoints.
record.rows_left_out: The README's performance, retrieval, truncation, and general task benchmark results do not measure the claim versions. The listed evaluation JSON files were not read independently.

untested.parts: Only one checkpoint was tested, with thinking off. Refusal under thinking=max (the shipped default) is not reported. There is no stock-vs-edited capability comparison, and no prompt-set or judge details.
The direction's construction (difference-in-means) is not stated. Addition-induced refusal and preservation of abilities are not measured.
The model has a thinking mode, but the refusal eval ran with thinking off only.

missing.what: Cited result: the upstream 0731 ablit checkpoint also reached 32/32 bypass. It comes from another repo and should not be a row, but it could inform a cross-model note.

record.verdict_notes: This is an engineering/integration repo, not peer-reviewed. The refusal eval is counts only, on 32 prompts, with no judge description. The direction is inherited from another repo and its derivation is unstated. λ=3.5 exceeds plain projection removal. Performance and truncation benchmarks were run on the edited model only and do not constitute a capability-preservation check.

versions.untested_parts: The README does not test the specified difference-in-means direction, ablation at every layer and position, addition-induced refusal, or preservation of other abilities.
Only the named Vision-EXP checkpoint is evaluated; results on other released models are not reported.
No jailbreak attack or training against ablation is evaluated.
No comparison of one direction with affine, cone, or multiple-direction accounts is reported.
No separate harmfulness judgment and refusal-decision measurement is reported.
No cross-language, cross-variant, or base-to-instruct transfer evaluation is reported.
No comparison of refusal-training procedures or stages is reported.
No evaluation of reasoning models for V1 is reported.

rows.subject: stock Vision-EXP
rows.note: Stock checkpoint comparison for the abliteration result.
rows.check: This is the stock-model baseline, not an effect measurement. It is correct as a comparator: 25/32 refusals, 7/32 bypass.

rows.subject: drowzeys/keys-DeepSeekV4Flash-Vision-EXP-ablit
rows.operation_detail: Anchored wo_b projection, λ=3.5, k=1, layers 10–35 only; 26 tensors
rows.locator: README, Safety-removal verification table; The abliteration
rows.note: The README says the result matches the upstream 0731 ablit result. It describes an anchored projection on layers 10–35, not an edit at every layer and position.
rows.check: Values match the README: 32/32 bypass, 0 refusals, 0 garbled. The note should add two things. The edit uses λ=3.5, which is not a pure orthogonal ablation (λ=1). The README never states how r was derived; it is credited to the 0731 anchored-tensors repo.

relationships.condition: Abliterated Vision-EXP checkpoint; 32 prompts, temp 0, thinking off
relationships.reason: Refusals fell from 25/32 in the stock model to 0/32 after the weight edit, with no garbled outputs (r1, r2). This is a small count-only eval with no uncertainty.
relationships.display_finding: Refusals fell from 25/32 to 0/32 after editing, with no garbled outputs.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.

reader_labels.label: supports
reader_labels.reason: The edited checkpoint has 32/32 bypasses and zero refusals in the reported evaluation, compared with 25 refusals in the stock checkpoint (r1, r2).
